horizon.extras.wheel_cycles_list_setting: The scroll wheel over a button in a settings list changes its value. Off, as in vanilla, the wheel scrolls the list.
horizon.extras.fullbright.tooltip: Show blocks and entities at full light, even in dark areas.
horizon.extras.dynamic_lights.tooltip: Torches and other light sources held, dropped or on fire light the blocks around them.
horizon.extras.own_name_tag.tooltip: Shows your name above your head in third person, as other players see it. Hidden when the server hides your team's names or you're invisible.
horizon.extras.hide_block_particles.tool: Hides the debris particles that burst from a broken block and crumble off the one you mine. Other particles stay.
horizon.extras.auto_reconnect.tooltip: Rejoins a server after a lost connection or a restart, never after a kick or ban.
horizon.extras.ui_sound_reserve.tooltip: Sounds in the world leave 16 of the 247 sound channels free, so a flood of them (a big explosion) can't silence menu clicks.
horizon.extras.music_page.tooltip: Music & Sounds gets a Music... page: play any built-in track now, or turn one off so the game stops picking it. Nothing changes until you turn a track off.
horizon.extras.mouse_tweaks.tooltip: Right-drag places one per slot, left-drag gathers the held item, Shift + left-drag moves every slot.
horizon.extras.mouse_tweaks_wheel.toolti: Down sends one item of the slot to the other side, up brings one back.
horizon.extras.sort.tooltip: Sorts the inventory, chests, barrels, ender chests and shulker boxes in creative tab order, merging stacks.
horizon.extras.sort_key.tooltip: Sorts the part under the cursor. Click, then press a key; Escape unbinds it.
horizon.extras.no_ai.tooltip: Hides and turns off every AI feature: agent control, horizon-ctl and the MCP servers. The launcher's switch too.
horizon.extras.agent_control.tooltip: Your own AI agent can play this game through horizon-ctl or an MCP client, on this computer only.
horizon.extras.discord_presence.tooltip: Shows Playing Horizon on your Discord profile while Discord runs: menus, single player or multiplayer, the dimension and the time played. Never a world's name or a server's address.

horizon.extras.chat_animation.tooltip: A new chat line slides in from the left while it fades in, instead of appearing whole.
horizon.extras.chat_indicator.tooltip: The coloured bar at the left of a chat line.
horizon.extras.pack_browser.tooltip: Select Resource Packs gets an Add button that searches Modrinth and installs a pack into your packs folder. Off, the game never contacts Modrinth.
horizon.extras.splitscreen.tooltip: In a world, another controller can join as a new player: press A when it asks, then pick a profile and where to play.

horizon.extras.cosmetics_mine.tooltip: Hidden: every Horizon player sees you without your cosmetics, you included. The same switch as the launcher's Wardrobe.

horizon.emote_wheel.retry: Could not load all emotes. Retrying shortly…
horizon.emote_wheel.help: Release or click to play · 1–8 · Esc closes
horizon.extras.cosmetics_others.tooltip: What other Horizon players wear: everything, only their name tag styles, or nothing. Hidden unless you own cosmetics, until you choose. Hidden, the game never asks what they wear.
horizon.extras.cosmetics_hide_fx: Hide other players' trails and auras
horizon.extras.cosmetics_hide_fx.tooltip: Other players' trails and auras stay hidden; their other cosmetics still show. Off by default.
horizon.tempban.dedicated_required: Temporary bans need a dedicated server
horizon.extras.cosmetics_solo.tooltip: Show your cosmetics and your name tag's badge in your single-player worlds too (your name tag with Own name tag). Off: only on servers.
horizon.extras.horizon_marks.tooltip: Show the Horizon logo next to Horizon players: a small logo before the names of other players who use Horizon, above their heads and in the player list. Only Horizon players see it: servers receive nothing.
horizon.extras.horizon_me.tooltip: Show me as a Horizon player: other Horizon players see the logo by your name. On, the service answers anyone who asks about you that you played Horizon in the last 3 hours; off, it never reports you.
horizon.pages.pvp.tooltip: Crosshair, HUD and PvP settings, all off by default. Nothing here shows what vanilla doesn't.
horizon.pvp.crosshair.tooltip: Draws your own crosshair instead of vanilla's. Its first settings look like vanilla's.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_shape.tooltip: A cross, a T, an X, a circle, a square or only a dot.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_size.tooltip: The length of each arm, in GUI pixels.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_gap.tooltip: The empty space in the middle.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_colour.tooltip: Inverted shows the colour under it inverted, as vanilla's crosshair does.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_outline.tooltip: A thin black edge, so it shows on any background.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_dot.tooltip: A dot in the middle of the crosshair.
horizon.pvp.crosshair_hover.tooltip: Another colour while the crosshair is over a mob or a player you could hit, as vanilla's attack indicator knows it.
horizon.pvp.outline.tooltip: Changes the outline around the block you look at.
horizon.pvp.outline_colour.tooltip: The outline's colour. Black at 40% is vanilla's.
horizon.pvp.outline_thickness.tooltip: The outline's width, in times vanilla's.
horizon.pvp.outline_fill.tooltip: Tints the faces of the block you look at, lightly.
horizon.pvp.hit.tooltip: Changes the colour mobs and players flash when they are hurt. Red at 30% is vanilla's.
horizon.pvp.hit_colour.tooltip: The colour hurt mobs and players flash.
horizon.pvp.hit_opacity.tooltip: How much of the colour covers them.
horizon.pvp.hud_armour.tooltip: The armour you wear, head first, with how many uses each piece has left.
horizon.pvp.hud_armour_percent.tooltip: Uses left as a percent of the piece's maximum instead of a number.
horizon.pvp.hud_effects.tooltip: Your effects with their names, levels and time left, in place of the icons at the top right.
horizon.pvp.hud_held.tooltip: How many of the item in your hand your inventory holds; arrows with a bow or crossbow.
horizon.pvp.hud_background.tooltip: A dark box behind each widget.
horizon.pvp.hud_opacity.tooltip: How dark the boxes behind the widgets are.
horizon.pvp.hud_text_colour.tooltip: The widgets' text colour. Durability keeps its green to red.
horizon.pvp.hud_shadow.tooltip: A shadow under the widgets' text, as vanilla's HUD text has.
horizon.pvp.hud_ping.tooltip: The latency the server reports for you, in milliseconds. Multiplayer only.
horizon.pvp.hud_coords.tooltip: Your block position and the direction you face, as F3 shows them. Hidden when the world or server reduces F3.
horizon.pvp.hud_server.tooltip: The address of the server you play on. Multiplayer only.
horizon.pvp.hud_combo.tooltip: Hits in a row the server confirmed, until you are hurt or 3 seconds pass without one.
horizon.pvp.hud_fps.tooltip: Frames drawn in the last second.
horizon.pvp.hud_cps.tooltip: Your left and right clicks in the last second.
horizon.pvp.hud_cps_corner.tooltip: Where the clicks per second show.
horizon.pvp.hud_keys.tooltip: Your movement keys, mouse buttons and jump, lit while you hold them, with clicks per second.
horizon.pvp.hud_reach.tooltip: How far from your eyes your last hit landed, for 3 seconds. It only measures: your reach stays vanilla's.
horizon.pvp.hud_speed.tooltip: How fast you move across the ground, in blocks per second.
horizon.pvp.numeric_enchants.tooltip: Tooltips and the enchanting table show Sharpness 5 instead of Sharpness V.
horizon.pvp.fire_lower.tooltip: Moves the flames you see while burning down, so they cover less of the screen.
horizon.pvp.shield_size.tooltip: The size of the shield in your hand, in first person.
horizon.pvp.totem_size.tooltip: The size of the totem that fills the screen when it saves you.
horizon.pvp.glint_colour.tooltip: The colour of the shimmer on enchanted items and armour. Off is vanilla's purple.
horizon.pvp.clear_water.tooltip: Under water, see as far as vanilla lets you after 30 seconds there, from the start.
horizon.pvp.clear_lava.tooltip: In lava, see as far as vanilla's Fire Resistance lets you, without the effect.
horizon.pvp.view_time.tooltip: The time of day you see: the sky and its light only. The world's time goes on and nothing is sent to the server.
horizon.pvp.view_weather.tooltip: The weather you see: rain, its light and fog only. The world's weather goes on and nothing is sent to the server.
horizon.pvp.chat_timestamps.tooltip: The time each message came in, before it.
horizon.pvp.chat_compact.tooltip: A message repeated in a row shows once, with how many times it came: (x3).
horizon.pvp.chat_copy.tooltip: Clicking a message in the open chat copies its text, unless the click does something else.
horizon.pvp.chat_search.tooltip: Ctrl+F in the open chat: what you type shows only the messages holding it. Enter or Ctrl+F again stops.
horizon.pvp.preset.tooltip: Turns on the custom crosshair, the armour and effects widgets, toggle sprint and sneak, lower fire, and the FPS counter and keystrokes mods if installed. Your settings for each stay.
horizon.pvp.hud_editor_key.tooltip: Opens the HUD editor from the game. Click, then press a key; Escape unbinds it.
horizon.pvp.editor.tooltip: Move the widgets on the game: drag them anywhere, resize them with the wheel, right click one to put it back in its corner.
horizon.pvp.editor.hint: Drag widgets · Wheel: size · Right click: back to its corner
horizon.pvp.combat_feel.tooltip: Legacy draws fights as 1.8.9 did: the item in your hand, its swing, eating, the bow and a sword held up while you hold use, without the dip after each hit or the attack indicator. Only the look: what you send a server stays the same.
horizon.pvp.combat_indicator.tooltip: Keeps the attack indicator under Legacy, which 1.8.9 didn't have.
horizon.pvp.combat_sounds.tooltip: Under Legacy, leaves out the attack sounds 1.9 added (strong, weak, sweep, critical...). Hurt sounds stay.
horizon.pvp.combat_rules.tooltip: Single player and the worlds you open to LAN fight by 1.8.9's rules: no attack cooldown or sweep, 1.8 weapon damage, Strength, Sharpness and critical hits. Servers you join keep their own rules.
